sources.entry: SeedDMS - Document Management System with workflows, access rights, fulltext search, and more. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.name: SeedDMS
summary.one_liner: SeedDMS is a free, open source, PHP-based document management system with a web interface, self-hostable and in development for over 10 years.
keywords: alternative to paid document management software
use_cases: full text searching of stored files
summary.what_it_does: ["SeedDMS is a PHP-based document management system focused on storing documents and the workflow that starts once a document enters the system. It has an easy-to-use web-based user interface. It can be self-hosted. According to the page, it offers workflows, access rights, and fulltext search. It provides extensions and an API to support integration, such as getting paper documents into the system. The page notes that SeedDMS itself does not create or scan documents; it is paired with a separate web scanning application, scanservjs, for that purpose."]
notable: Developed for more than 10 years and in active development
Workflows, access rights, and fulltext search
Extensions and an API for integration
Pairs with scanservjs web scanning application for paper-to-DMS workflow
caveats: SeedDMS does not create or scan documents itself; scanning requires a separate tool such as scanservjs
Page text is short and does not state a specific license version beyond the awesome-selfhosted listing (GPL-2.0)
